topics.label: Introduction to Inflammation Initiation and Resolution
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture topic on how immune components coordinate to initiate and resolve inflammatory reactions.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms by which the innate immune system detects infection and cellular injury through conserved molecular patterns, receptor families, and intracellular sensing complexes.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade: Cellular Activation, Trafficking, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular and physiological processes that execute an inflammatory response, from sentinel cell activation and leukocyte recruitment to lymphatic drainage and systemic pathology.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms responsible for shutting down inflammation, repairing damaged tissue, and establishing chronic or granulomatous responses when inflammation cannot be fully resolved.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Topic
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and announces the subject of the next lecture.
